en.answer:
Yes, it can be.

The restrictions that prevents you from Special Summoning monsters from the Extra Deck, except Fiend monsters, applies after the effect has resolved.
en.question: Can the effect of <<15626>> that Special Summons 1 "Lil-la" monster from your Graveyard be activated during the turn where you already successfully Special Summoned a non-Fiend monster from the Extra Deck?
